extraction.name: MMStar
extraction.description: MMStar is an elite vision-indispensable multi-modal benchmark comprising 1,500 samples meticulously selected by humans. MMStar benchmarks 6 core capabilities and 18 detailed axes, aiming to evaluate LVLMs' multi-modal capacities with carefully balanced and purified samples. Samples are selected using an automated LLM filtering pipeline followed by strict manual review to ensure visual dependency, minimal data leakage, and the requirement of advanced multi-modal capabilities.
extraction.creator: Lin Chen, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Samples are initially gathered from existing benchmarks (MMBench, SEED-Bench, MMMU, ScienceQA, AI2D, MathVista), totaling 22,401 samples. An automated coarse filter utilizing eight LLMs (two closed-source: GPT4-Turbo, GeminiPro; six open-source: LLaMA-70B, Qwen-1.5-72B, Mixtral-8x7B, InternLM2-20B, Yi-34B, Deepseek-67B) filters out samples that could be answered by more than 2 LLMs without visual inputs, narrowing the pool to 11,607 candidate samples. Subsequently, three experts conduct a manual review based on visual dependency, capability dimension coverage, and difficulty (gauged by 16 LVLMs split into four difficulty tiers), curating 1,500 high-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing multi-modal benchmarks: MMBench, SEED-Bench, MMMU, ScienceQA, AI2D, and MathVista.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: All questions are ensured to be converted into a multiple-choice format to allow heuristic matching rules to calculate accuracy, avoiding the need for LLM-based answer extraction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Manual review and selection by three human experts to ensure each sample's answer is based on visual content understanding, covers comprehensive capability assessment dimensions, and requires advanced multi-modal abilities.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: VLMEvalKit, GPT4-Turbo, GeminiPro, LLaMA-70B, Qwen-1.5-72B, Mixtral-8x7B, InternLM2-20B, Yi-34B, Deepseek-67B, and 16 LVLMs (including GPT4V, GeminiPro-Vision, LLaVA series).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to expand MMStar into a larger, online test set and explore dynamic evaluation methods to maintain sample visual dependency and reduce accidental data leakage.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-modal capabilities, measuring actual multi-modal performance gains (MG) and multi-modal training data leakage (ML).
